code: read_wfs(   service,   layer = NULL,   srs = "EPSG:25833",   version = c("2.0.0", "1.1.0", "1.0.0"),   output_format = "application/json",   count = NULL,   start_index = NULL,   host = "https://gdi.berlin.de/services/wfs",   quiet = FALSE )

title: Read a WFS layer from the Berlin Geoportal — read_wfs
text: service service name, see wfs_base_url(), full endpoint URL. layer feature type request. Either fully qualified name (e.g. "wsg:wsg") bare layer name, case service name used namespace prefix. NULL (default) service asked feature types via list_wfs_layers(); succeeds service offers exactly one. srs coordinate reference system response (default: "EPSG:25833", ETRS89 / UTM 33N used Berlin services). version WFS version, one "2.0.0" (default), "1.1.0", "1.0.0". output_format value OUTPUTFORMAT (default: "application/json", .e. GeoJSON). Pass NULL let server choose, usually yields GML. count maximum number features return, NULL (default) . Sent COUNT WFS 2.0.0 MAXFEATURES otherwise. start_index index first feature return, NULL (default). Together count allows paging layers exceed server's response limit. WFS 2.0.0 . host see wfs_base_url(). quiet suppress progress messages sf::read_sf() function (default: FALSE).

kwb.geoportal 0.0.0.9000
text: Added read_wfs(), downloads one feature type Berlin Geoportal WFS service returns sf object. complements metadata functions: read_metadata() says dataset lives, read_wfs() fetches . Adds sf Imports. Added list_wfs_layers(), reads service’s GetCapabilities document returns one row per feature type. authoritative way find layer pass read_wfs(). Added find_wfs(), searches catalogue read read_metadata_all() records offering download service returns one row per matching WFS link, including service name read_wfs() expects. Added wfs_base_url() wfs_service_name() small helpers around endpoint URLs. Added NEWS.md file track changes package. see https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html writing good NEWS.md
